_comment: Captured from the pre-restructure code (discretize.py @ --resolution 10) before Phase 1. rv3032_example is Gerber-sourced; odb_kitchen_sink and hella are ODB++-sourced. hella's value here predates the D11 attrlist-whitespace fix, so the post-fix copper layer thickness differs (0.035 -> 0.036614 mm) even though the raster copper_fraction itself is a 2D quantity unaffected by that fix.
